words.meaning: and the Prophets (Nevi'im) [the third part of the Old Testament was the Ketuvim - the writings (Psalms, Proverbs, etc.)
words.plain: Law [Hebrew: Torah] and the Prophets [Hebrew: Nevi'im] together make up two of the three sections of the Hebrew Bible. The third is the Writings [Hebrew: Ketuvim — Psalms, Proverbs, and others]. When Jesus says he came not to destroy 'the Law and the Prophets,' he's referring to essentially the entire Hebrew scripture.
